page: Microsoft Azure M12s_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine within the MSMediumMemoryv3 family, deployed through Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is provisioned with 12 dedicated virtual processor cores built on the x86_64 Intel architecture. It features 240.0 GB of system memory, delivering a dense ratio of 20.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Hardware acceleration is not included, with a GPU count of zero. The instance does not provide local ephemeral disk storage, requiring deployments to attach external network volumes via its Premium Storage capability for operating system and data persistence. Public IPv4 networking requires independent allocation, as zero complimentary public addresses are supplied.

From an architectural standpoint, the instance trades high vCPU density and local storage IOPS for substantial memory capacity per core. This configuration avoids excess compute licensing or processor overhead when a system primarily demands large RAM allocations. The M12s_v3 is targeted at workloads such as mid-sized in-memory databases, large caching layers, and memory-constrained enterprise analytics.
description: Microsoft Azure M12s_v3 is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine instance from the MSMediumMemoryv3 series, provisioned via Microsoft Hyper-V with dedicated Intel CPU resources. The hardware configuration pairs 12 dedicated vCPUs with 240.0 GB of system memory, yielding an extensive allocation ratio of 20.0 GB of RAM per virtual processor. There is no integrated local storage and no dedicated GPU hardware included, meaning persistent block storage operations depend entirely on remote Premium Storage options. The instance prioritizes high memory capacity per core over dense core counts, optimizing host infrastructure investment for memory-bound applications without paying for unneeded CPU processing power. This specific architectural balance aligns directly with enterprise workloads requiring substantial memory spaces, such as medium-scale in-memory databases, distributed caching platforms, enterprise resource planning components, and complex data transformation jobs.
